name.fr-FR: Documents de saint Vincent de Paul
name.en-US: Documents of St. Vincent de Paul
name.pt-BR: Documentos de São Vicente de Paulo

description.fr-FR: Les documents réunis par Pierre Coste au tome XIII : pièces relatives à la vie de saint Vincent, règlements et actes de la Congrégation de la Mission, règlements des confréries de la Charité, des Filles de la Charité et des Dames de la Charité, conseils, canevas d’entretien, suppléments.
description.en-US: The documents gathered by Pierre Coste in tome XIII: papers on the life of St. Vincent, regulations and acts of the Congregation of the Mission, rules of the Confraternities of Charity, of the Daughters of Charity and of the Ladies of Charity, councils, outlines of conferences, supplements.
description.pt-BR: Os documentos reunidos por Pierre Coste no tomo XIII: peças sobre a vida de São Vicente, regulamentos da Congregação da Missão, regras das Confrarias da Caridade, das Filhas da Caridade e das Damas da Caridade.

sources.edition: Saint Vincent de Paul, Correspondance, entretiens, documents, éd. Pierre Coste C.M., Paris: Gabalda, 1920-1925, tome XIII; digital edition by P. Claude Lautissier C.M. and the Daughters of Charity (1992), on JesusMarie.com.
sources.description: All numbered documents of Coste’s tome XIII, one per chapter, with notes; Latin documents are followed by Coste’s French translation. The supplements after document 202 are one chapter.
sources.tierEvidence: Vincent died in 1660; Coste’s edition appeared in 1920-25 and Coste died in 1935. The digital transcription is of the same text, with Coste’s notes.
